summary: Implemented the desktop Admin account, seeker, provider, and provider-document review surfaces for ADM-02 through ADM-05 using the implemented admin account and reviewer document-access contracts. The UI is localized for Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese, preserves RTL/LTR direction, handles loading, empty, error, retry, not-found, success, and permission states, and opens only clean active documents through a short-lived reviewer grant.

verification.notes: Web TypeScript compilation passed, including the new feature and test files.
Web ESLint passed with zero warnings.

verification.command: npm.cmd exec --workspace apps/web -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/admin-accounts.vitest.test.tsx
verification.notes: Focused Admin account regression suite passed 6/6 tests, including contract query/auth headers, all three locale directions, reviewer document access, private-field exclusion, and non-admin fail-closed behavior.

verification.command: npm.cmd exec --workspace apps/web -- playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/admin-accounts.spec.ts --project=desktop-ar --project=desktop-en --project=desktop-zh
verification.notes: Desktop visual and browser matrix passed 9/9 across Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese. ADM-02 through ADM-05 routes, reviewer access, inactive-document disabling, focus, direction, safe projections, and non-admin access were verified.

verification.command: npm.cmd exec --workspace apps/web -- playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/admin-accounts-accessibility.spec.ts --project=desktop-ar --project=desktop-en --project=desktop-zh
verification.notes: Accessibility and keyboard matrix passed 6/6 across the three approved desktop locales, including landmarks, table labels, focus order, direction, safe projections, and permission behavior.
Full web suite passed: 36 Vitest files / 243 tests and 76 TAP checks.
Web client and SSR builds passed; Vite emitted only the existing large-chunk warning.
Root configuration, contracts, API, and web typecheck passed.
Root workspace check and lint passed.
Root configuration, API, and web test matrix passed.
Root contracts, API, and web build passed.

Inventory confirms GET /api/v1/admin/users, GET /api/v1/admin/users/:userId, GET /api/v1/admin/providers, GET /api/v1/admin/providers/:providerId, and GET /api/v1/admin/provider-documents/:documentId/access are implemented.
No whitespace errors in the worktree diff.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx is outside the selected task's listed roots and was changed only as the necessary route-composition integration for the new Admin feature; this exception is explicitly recorded rather than silently expanding scope.
Browser route handlers and fixtures are test-only deterministic contract fixtures; no production mock data, dependencies, contracts, API behavior, or database models were changed by frontend_061.

The initial browser run exposed and corrected a test-only 22-character document fixture ID; the shared contract requires a 24-character object ID. The final visual and reviewer-access matrices passed after correction.
knownGaps: Admin dashboard device scope is desktop-only in the approved design manifest; tablet and mobile runs were intentionally skipped and are not claimed.
No live production or database smoke test was run; deterministic contract/component/browser coverage and the runtime inventory cover this frontend boundary.
